# Context

This script creates the avoidable hospitalizations outcome by beneficiary-month, using the Prevention Quality Indicators in Inpatient Settings (PQIs) developed by the Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality ([AHRQ](https://qualityindicators.ahrq.gov/)). PQIs identify inpatient hospital admissions for conditions considered potentially preventable with effective outpatient care (e.g. diabetes complications, COPD, hypertension, heart failure). We used the 2025 AHRQ technical specifications to build `pqi_lookup.csv`, a code lookup table included in this repo with the diagnosis and procedure codes needed to flag each individual PQI below.

AHRQ provides guidance for combining individual PQIs into composite measures. We only construct PQI 90 (Prevention Quality Overall Composite), which flags a hospitalization as an avoidable hospitalization if it meets the inclusion/exclusion criteria for any of the 10 individual PQIs that make it up.

This code picks up from the inpatient claim-line table (`ip_claim`) described in `select_code_to_identify_all-cause_hospitalizations.Rmd`, after the HEDIS-based filtering steps in that script but before claims are rolled up to one row per stay, with these additional variables:

- sex
- age (at the time of the claim)
- icd_dgns_cd1...icd_dgns_cd25 (up to 25 diagnosis codes)
- admtg_dgns_cd (admitting diagnosis code)
- icd_prcdr_cd1...icd_prcdr_cd13 (up to 13 procedure codes)
- drg_cd

This code also assumes the user has an enrollee-month cohort table called `mbsf` (as described in `select_code_to_identify_same_insurer_status.Rmd`). Note our cohort is restricted to beneficiaries ages 65+, so the AHRQ-specified denominator of ages 18+ is a formality here, but we include it for methodological completeness/transparency.


# Load PQI lookup table

```{r}
pqi_lookup <- fread("pqi_lookup.csv")

# up to 25 dx codes per claim, including the admitting diagnosis
dx_cols  <- c(paste0("icd_dgns_cd", 1:25), "admtg_dgns_cd")

# up to 13 procedure codes per claim
pcs_cols <- paste0("icd_prcdr_cd", 1:13)
```


# Apply minimal exclusion criteria

AHRQ specifies excluding discharges with an ungroupable DRG, or missing sex, age, year, or principal diagnosis.

```{r}
ip_claim <- ip_claim[drg_cd != 999 & !is.na(sex) & !is.na(age) & !is.na(year) & !is.na(icd_dgns_cd1)]
```

Note: `icd_dgns_cd1` (principal diagnosis) and `admtg_dgns_cd` (admitting diagnosis) often differ on the same claim, so each PQI numerator below checks both fields for the relevant diagnosis code.


# PQI 01: Diabetes Short-Term Complications Admission Rate

Numerator: hospital discharges, for patients ages 18+, with a principal diagnosis for diabetes with short-term complications (ketoacidosis, hyperosmolarity, or coma).

```{r}
# get codes for this indicator
diabetes_short_term_icd <- pqi_lookup[code_set == "ACDIASD" & pqi_id == "PQI_01"]$code

# flag numerator
ip_claim[, pqi_01_num := age >= 18 &
            (icd_dgns_cd1 %in% diabetes_short_term_icd | admtg_dgns_cd %in% diabetes_short_term_icd)]
```


# PQI 03: Diabetes Long-Term Complications Admission Rate

Numerator: hospital discharges, for patients ages 18+, with a principal diagnosis for diabetes with long-term complications (renal, eye, neurological, circulatory, other specified, or unspecified).

```{r}
# get codes for this indicator
diabetes_long_term_icd <- pqi_lookup[code_set == "ACDIALD" & pqi_id == "PQI_03"]$code

# flag numerator
ip_claim[, pqi_03_num := age >= 18 &
            (icd_dgns_cd1 %in% diabetes_long_term_icd | admtg_dgns_cd %in% diabetes_long_term_icd)]
```


# PQI 05: COPD or Asthma in Older Adults Admission Rate

Numerator: hospital discharges, for patients ages 40+, with a principal diagnosis for COPD (excluding acute bronchitis) or asthma.
Exclusion: any listed diagnosis for cystic fibrosis or an anomaly of the respiratory system.

```{r}
# get codes for this indicator
copd_icd <- pqi_lookup[code_set == "ACCOPDD" & pqi_id == "PQI_05"]$code
asthma_icd <- pqi_lookup[code_set == "ACSASTD" & pqi_id == "PQI_05"]$code
cf_icd <- pqi_lookup[code_set == "RESPAN" & pqi_id == "PQI_05"]$code

# flag numerator
ip_claim[, pqi_05_num := age >= 40 &
            (icd_dgns_cd1 %in% copd_icd | icd_dgns_cd1 %in% asthma_icd |
               admtg_dgns_cd %in% copd_icd | admtg_dgns_cd %in% asthma_icd)]

# apply exclusion: drop claims with a listed diagnosis anywhere in dx_cols
ip_claim[pqi_05_num == T, pqi_05_num := !Reduce(`|`, lapply(.SD, `%in%`, cf_icd)), .SDcols = dx_cols]
```


# PQI 07: Hypertension Admission Rate

Numerator: hospital discharges, for patients ages 18+, with a principal diagnosis for hypertension.
Exclusions: any listed cardiac procedure code; or a listed chronic kidney disease diagnosis accompanied by a listed dialysis access procedure code.

```{r}
# get codes for this indicator
hyp_icd <- pqi_lookup[code_set == "ACSHYPD" & pqi_id == "PQI_07"]$code
cardiac_pcs <- pqi_lookup[code_set == "ACSCARP" & pqi_id == "PQI_07"]$code
ckd_icd <- pqi_lookup[code_set == "ACSHY2D" & pqi_id == "PQI_07"]$code
dialysis_pcs <- pqi_lookup[code_set == "DIALY2P" & pqi_id == "PQI_07"]$code

# flag numerator
ip_claim[, pqi_07_num := age >= 18 & (icd_dgns_cd1 %in% hyp_icd | admtg_dgns_cd %in% hyp_icd)]

# apply cardiac procedure exclusion
ip_claim[pqi_07_num == T, pqi_07_num := !Reduce(`|`, lapply(.SD, `%in%`, cardiac_pcs)), .SDcols = pcs_cols]

# apply CKD + dialysis access exclusion
ip_claim[pqi_07_num == T, has_ckd_dx := Reduce(`|`, lapply(.SD, `%in%`, ckd_icd)), .SDcols = dx_cols]
ip_claim[pqi_07_num == T, has_dialysis_pcs := Reduce(`|`, lapply(.SD, `%in%`, dialysis_pcs)), .SDcols = pcs_cols]
ip_claim[pqi_07_num == T, pqi_07_num := !(has_ckd_dx & has_dialysis_pcs)]

# clean up helper columns
ip_claim[, c("has_ckd_dx", "has_dialysis_pcs") := NULL]
```


# PQI 08: Heart Failure Admission Rate

Numerator: hospital discharges, for patients ages 18+, with a principal diagnosis for heart failure.
Exclusion: any listed cardiac procedure code.

```{r}
# get codes for this indicator
heart_failure_icd <- pqi_lookup[code_set == "MRTCHFD" & pqi_id == "PQI_08"]$code
cardiac_pcs <- pqi_lookup[code_set == "ACSCARP" & pqi_id == "PQI_08"]$code

# flag numerator
ip_claim[, pqi_08_num := age >= 18 & (icd_dgns_cd1 %in% heart_failure_icd | admtg_dgns_cd %in% heart_failure_icd)]

# apply cardiac procedure exclusion
ip_claim[pqi_08_num == T, pqi_08_num := !Reduce(`|`, lapply(.SD, `%in%`, cardiac_pcs)), .SDcols = pcs_cols]
```


# PQI 11: Community-Acquired Pneumonia Admission Rate

Numerator: hospital discharges, for patients ages 18+, with a principal diagnosis for community-acquired pneumonia.
Exclusions: any listed diagnosis for sickle cell/Hemoglobin S disease; or any listed diagnosis or procedure code for an immunocompromised state.

```{r}
# get codes for this indicator
pneumonia_icd <- pqi_lookup[code_set == "ACSBACD" & pqi_id == "PQI_11"]$code
sickle_cell_icd <- pqi_lookup[code_set == "ACSBA2D" & pqi_id == "PQI_11"]$code
immunoc_icd <- pqi_lookup[code_set == "IMMUNID" & pqi_id == "PQI_11"]$code
immunoc_pcs <- pqi_lookup[code_set == "IMMUNIP" & pqi_id == "PQI_11"]$code

# flag numerator
ip_claim[, pqi_11_num := age >= 18 & (icd_dgns_cd1 %in% pneumonia_icd | admtg_dgns_cd %in% pneumonia_icd)]

# apply sickle cell exclusion
ip_claim[pqi_11_num == T, pqi_11_num := !Reduce(`|`, lapply(.SD, `%in%`, sickle_cell_icd)), .SDcols = dx_cols]

# apply immunocompromised exclusion
ip_claim[pqi_11_num == T, immunid := Reduce(`|`, lapply(.SD, `%in%`, immunoc_icd)), .SDcols = dx_cols]
ip_claim[pqi_11_num == T, immunip := Reduce(`|`, lapply(.SD, `%in%`, immunoc_pcs)), .SDcols = pcs_cols]
ip_claim[pqi_11_num == T, pqi_11_num := !(immunid | immunip)]

# clean up helper columns
ip_claim[, c("immunid", "immunip") := NULL]
```


# PQI 12: Urinary Tract Infection Admission Rate

Numerator: hospital discharges, for patients ages 18+, with a principal diagnosis for urinary tract infection.
Exclusions: any listed diagnosis for a kidney/urinary tract disorder; or any listed diagnosis or procedure code for an immunocompromised state.

```{r}
# get codes for this indicator
uti_icd <- pqi_lookup[code_set == "ACSUTID" & pqi_id == "PQI_12"]$code
kidney_utd_icd <- pqi_lookup[code_set == "KIDNEY" & pqi_id == "PQI_12"]$code
immunoc_icd <- pqi_lookup[code_set == "IMMUNID" & pqi_id == "PQI_12"]$code
immunoc_pcs <- pqi_lookup[code_set == "IMMUNIP" & pqi_id == "PQI_12"]$code

# flag numerator
ip_claim[, pqi_12_num := age >= 18 & (icd_dgns_cd1 %in% uti_icd | admtg_dgns_cd %in% uti_icd)]

# apply kidney/urinary tract disorder exclusion
ip_claim[pqi_12_num == T, pqi_12_num := !Reduce(`|`, lapply(.SD, `%in%`, kidney_utd_icd)), .SDcols = dx_cols]

# apply immunocompromised exclusion
ip_claim[pqi_12_num == T, immunid := Reduce(`|`, lapply(.SD, `%in%`, immunoc_icd)), .SDcols = dx_cols]
ip_claim[pqi_12_num == T, immunip := Reduce(`|`, lapply(.SD, `%in%`, immunoc_pcs)), .SDcols = pcs_cols]
ip_claim[pqi_12_num == T, pqi_12_num := !(immunid | immunip)]

# clean up helper columns
ip_claim[, c("immunid", "immunip") := NULL]
```


# PQI 14: Uncontrolled Diabetes Admission Rate

Numerator: hospital discharges, for patients ages 18+, with a principal diagnosis for uncontrolled diabetes without mention of a short-term or long-term complication.

```{r}
# get codes for this indicator
diabetes_icd <- pqi_lookup[code_set == "ACDIAUD" & pqi_id == "PQI_14"]$code

# flag numerator
ip_claim[, pqi_14_num := age >= 18 & (icd_dgns_cd1 %in% diabetes_icd | admtg_dgns_cd %in% diabetes_icd)]
```


# PQI 15: Asthma in Younger Adults Admission Rate

Numerator: hospital discharges, for patients ages 18-39, with a principal diagnosis for asthma.
Exclusion: any listed diagnosis for cystic fibrosis or an anomaly of the respiratory system.

```{r}
# get codes for this indicator
asthma_icd <- pqi_lookup[code_set == "ACSASTD" & pqi_id == "PQI_15"]$code
cf_icd <- pqi_lookup[code_set == "RESPAN" & pqi_id == "PQI_15"]$code

# flag numerator
ip_claim[, pqi_15_num := age %between% c(18, 39) & (icd_dgns_cd1 %in% asthma_icd | admtg_dgns_cd %in% asthma_icd)]

# apply exclusion
ip_claim[pqi_15_num == T, pqi_15_num := !Reduce(`|`, lapply(.SD, `%in%`, cf_icd)), .SDcols = dx_cols]
```

Note: this PQI is unlikely to contribute any cases in our cohort, which is restricted to ages 65+; we include it for completeness of the PQI 90 composite.


# PQI 16: Lower-Extremity Amputation Among Patients with Diabetes Rate

Numerator: hospital discharges, for patients ages 18+, with any listed lower-extremity amputation procedure code and any listed diabetes diagnosis.
Exclusion: any listed diagnosis for traumatic amputation of the lower extremity.

AHRQ's full specification also excludes claims with a principal diagnosis assigned to Major Diagnostic Category 14 (Pregnancy, Childbirth, and the Puerperium), using a variable only available in TAF claims. We skip that exclusion since amputation claims are rare among pregnant individuals and most amputation claims are in Medicare.

```{r}
# get codes for this indicator
lower_amp_pcs <- pqi_lookup[code_set == "ACSLEAP" & pqi_id == "PQI_16"]$code
diabetes_icd <- pqi_lookup[code_set == "ACSLEAD" & pqi_id == "PQI_16"]$code
traumatic_amp_icd <- pqi_lookup[code_set == "ACLEA2D" & pqi_id == "PQI_16"]$code

# flag numerator
ip_claim[, lower_amp := Reduce(`|`, lapply(.SD, `%in%`, lower_amp_pcs)), .SDcols = pcs_cols]
ip_claim[, diabetes := Reduce(`|`, lapply(.SD, `%in%`, diabetes_icd)), .SDcols = dx_cols]
ip_claim[, pqi_16_num := age >= 18 & lower_amp & diabetes]

# apply traumatic amputation exclusion
ip_claim[pqi_16_num == T, pqi_16_num := !Reduce(`|`, lapply(.SD, `%in%`, traumatic_amp_icd)), .SDcols = dx_cols]

# clean up helper columns
ip_claim[, c("lower_amp", "diabetes") := NULL]
```


# Roll claims up to one row per stay

As in `select_code_to_identify_all-cause_hospitalizations.Rmd`, we don't count transfers as separate admissions, so we group claims for the same beneficiary that overlap or are contiguous into a single stay. A stay is flagged for a given PQI if any of its claims met that PQI's criteria.

```{r}
pqi_cols <- paste0("pqi_", c("01", "03", "05", "07", "08", "11", "12", "14", "15", "16"), "_num")

# roll each claim to a single row, carrying forward the max of each PQI flag
ip_visits_pqi <- ip_claim[, c(.(from_dt = min(from_dt), thru_dt = max(thru_dt)),
                              lapply(.SD, max)), by = .(bene_id, claim_id), .SDcols = pqi_cols]

setorder(ip_visits_pqi, bene_id, from_dt, thru_dt)

# group overlapping/contiguous claims into a stay
ip_visits_pqi[, stay_id := chse::overlapping(from_dt, thru_dt, maxgap = 0), by = bene_id]

# collapse to one row per stay, carrying forward the max of each PQI flag
ip_visits_pqi <- ip_visits_pqi[, c(.(from_dt = min(from_dt)), lapply(.SD, max)),
                               by = .(bene_id, stay_id), .SDcols = pqi_cols]
```


# Create PQI 90 composite

A stay is an avoidable hospitalization if it meets the numerator criteria for any of the 10 individual PQIs above.

```{r}
ip_visits_pqi[, pqi_90_num := as.integer(Reduce(`|`, .SD)), .SDcols = pqi_cols]
```


# Merge outcome to cohort table

We merge by `from_dt` (admission date) rather than discharge date, so the outcome reflects the month the hospitalization began.

```{r}
# assign each stay to its month of admission
ip_visits_pqi[, `:=` (calendar_mo = month(from_dt), year = year(from_dt))]

# a beneficiary can have more than one stay in a month; roll up to one row per beneficiary-month
ip_visits_pqi <- ip_visits_pqi[, .(pqi_90_num = max(pqi_90_num)), by = .(bene_id, calendar_mo, year)]

mbsf <- merge(mbsf, ip_visits_pqi[, .(bene_id, calendar_mo, year, pqi_90_num)],
              by = c("bene_id", "calendar_mo", "year"), all.x = T)

# bene-months with no avoidable hospitalization should be 0, not NA
setnafill(mbsf, fill = 0, cols = "pqi_90_num")

# AHRQ's denominator for this composite is the population ages 18+; our cohort is already 65+
mbsf[, pqi_denom := as.integer(age >= 18)]
```
